tierThresholds.name: Manager Review Tier
conditions: Direct supervisor validation of business justification

tierThresholds.name: High-Value Executive Approval
conditions: Formal vendor contract or quote attached
Final sign-off by CFO or Vice President

intelligentRules.name: Weekend Transaction Anomaly
intelligentRules.description: Flags transactions that occurred on Saturday or Sunday unless tagged as business travel or weekend event

intelligentRules.name: Split Transaction Evasion Detection
intelligentRules.description: Detects multiple expenses from same submitter within 48 hours to the same vendor totaling over threshold

intelligentRules.name: Department Budget Exhaustion Warning
intelligentRules.description: Triggered when the expense causes department or category budget utilization to cross 90%

intelligentRules.name: Meal Per-Diem Cap Exceedance
intelligentRules.description: Flags meal expenses where per-attendee cost exceeds $100 for dinner or $40 for lunch

intelligentRules.name: Duplicate Invoice Detection
intelligentRules.description: Matches exact vendor, date, and amount across existing approved or pending expenses
